name: ArenaStreams VR
summary:
Experience Corda Arena. Wherever you are.

ArenaStreams VR is the official VR app of Corda Arena, bringing live events from the physical venue into an immersive virtual environment.

Step inside the virtual Corda Arena, explore the Lobby and meet other visitors before the event begins. Connect with friends, network with other attendees at the virtual bar and experience the social side of an event — all from within VR.
